attractions.name: Tegallalang Rice Terrace
attractions.description: One of Bali's signature agricultural landscapes, with terraces cascading down the valley in layers of green; mainly a scenic and photographic stop.
tips: Wear comfortable footwear as paths can be uneven
Carry sunscreen, hats and water as afternoons can be warm
Swings, café food and drinks are optional and paid separately
